title: Courtyard House
description: A quiet, light-filled home built around a green heart and the rituals of everyday life.

cover.alt: Cartoon-style concept illustration of a peach living room with rounded seating opening onto a leafy courtyard; not a photograph

gallery.alt: Cartoon 3D house concept with peach walls, flat roof wings, and a planted central opening
gallery.title: A home around a green heart
gallery.description: Low roof wings frame a planted opening, exploring how a courtyard can bring daylight and greenery into the heart of a private residence.

gallery.alt: Isometric concept layout showing bedroom, living, and kitchen zones around a green courtyard
gallery.title: Courtyard-led planning
gallery.description: A diagrammatic cutaway connects everyday rooms around a small garden. It is a spatial concept, not a measured construction plan.

gallery.alt: Cartoon bedroom with a green bedspread, warm wood storage, and a garden-facing window
gallery.title: A quieter bedroom
gallery.description: Warm timber, a soft green textile palette, and garden-facing daylight extend the calm of the courtyard into a private resting space.

gallery.alt: Cartoon kitchen with warm wood cabinetry, a pale island, and green planting
gallery.title: Everyday kitchen rituals
gallery.description: Continuous counters, a central preparation island, and warm finishes make room for cooking, conversation, and unhurried mornings.

gallery.alt: Cartoon planted courtyard with a central tree, pergola beams, and a built-in bench
gallery.title: The planted courtyard
gallery.description: A leafy center, filtered overhead light, and a shaded bench create a place to pause between the home's daily routines.
